messages:
incident-bot: [PAGING] High error rate detected on /v1/generate (us-west-2). Threshold breach 5m. Paging oncall: alex
Alex: on call, seeing 500 spikes from the inference cluster. digging in now
Alex: running `kubectl -n prod logs deployment/inference --since=10m | grep -i error` to get context
Alex: quick snapshot — increased OOMs on node gpu-07 and timeouts 503 upstream
Maria: @Alex lmk if you need capacity/scale, I can push a resize
Alex: scaling a pool from 4 -> 8 to absorb burst. kicking off `redwood infra scale --pool inference-prod --replicas 8`
incident-bot: Deploy job queued by Alex (job id: dj-1799502468-001)
Alex: scaled, but some pods still crash due to OOM on model-quant-worker. rolling restart to pick new kernel
Jess: customer impact note: observed elevated 5xx for customers with large batch sizes (AcmeCorp, Paxio). CS alerted. severity=high :warning:
Ranjit: copying notes to incident channel and starting timeline doc — pls paste any important logs here
Alex: found a config mismatch — autoscaler minReplicas set to 1 for that pool, but a node eviction + heavy batch caused queue buildup.
Alex: temp mitigation: set autoscaler minReplicas=3 and applied a queue-throttle patch to reject >64 token batches with 429 to protect capacity
Maria: confirmed 429s reduced overall error flood. nice work. :thumbsup:
Alex: capturing commands used:
```
redwood infra patch hpa inference-prod --min 3
kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference -n prod
```
oncall-handoff: Alex -> Maria at 16:30 UTC
Alex: handing off now. summary: cause likely autoscaler + batch size spike; mitigation: scaled pool, enforced throttle, restarted pods. customer impact: transient 5xx/latency spike ~8min peak. logs and timeline in pinned doc.
Maria: taking over. I'll keep monitoring next 30m and then hand to night oncall
Sam: heads up — alerted support swap and CS has a post to impacted customers queued. template sent.
Leo: noise: I see slow KV cache growth correlating with 503s; collecting heap dumps now (will attach to timeline)
Ranjit: timeline entry -> 1799502468-incident-timeline.md (added heap dump, metrics graphs)
Jess: customer-facing update posted at 16:12 UTC: "We're experiencing degraded performance on generation endpoints; mitigation in progress, monitoring."
Maria: small follow-up: we still saw a few OOMs after restart; I disabled a new quantization flag on one model variant to reduce memory usage (reverted flag: modelX.quant_fast=true -> false)
Alex: that flag was rolled out in last week's release candidate — marking as contributing factor in notes
Maria: after 45m, error rate back to baseline. I'm comfortable closing active paging, but we need an RCA and action items
incident-bot: Incident marked stable by Maria at 17:05 UTC — paging cleared
Ranjit: scheduling post-incident review: proposed slot tomorrow 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC (1h). Please vote: ✅ I can, ❌ can't
Sam: ✅
Alex: ✅
Maria: ✅
Jess: ✅
Leo: ✅
Ranjit: meeting scheduled: https://meet.redwood.com/1799502468-rca-review
Ranjit: RCA draft created: https://docs.redwood.com/rcas/1799502468-autoscale-batch-oom (please don't edit the title — use comments)
Sam: drafting initial timeline and contributing factors now
Maria: action items I see so far (adding to doc comments):
- increase autoscaler minReplicas default from 1 -> 2 for inference-prod (owner: Leo, due: 2026-03-20)
- add a soft-limit on batch token size at gateway to reject >64 tokens (owner: Seung, due: 2026-03-18)
- revert aggressive quant flag until memory regression test added (owner: Jess, due: 2026-03-19)
- add memory smoke tests for model rollout (owner: Erin, due: 2026-03-25)
Alex: I'll add logs and the exact commands to the RCA under "Mitigations"
Leo: added heap dump link and memory graphs in the doc comments
Sam: pinging eng-oncall to review the draft before meeting — @eng-oncall any extra eyes?
eng-oncall: reviewing now, will add suggestions on checklist and triage steps
Ranjit: asking peer-reviewers to sign off after push: reviewers = [Maria, Leo, Erin]
Maria: review done — left inline comments on timeline accuracy
Leo: reviewed, flagged that autoscale metrics were misinterpreted in one graph (fixed)
Erin: quick pass done. LGTM pending timeline consolidation
Ranjit: final checklist before sign-off:
- [ ] timeline verified
- [ ] contributing factors documented
- [ ] action items owners + due dates
- [ ] customer impact summary and CS notes linked
Sam: all set on my end — timeline + mitigations in place
Jess: added CS follow-up task to reach out to enterprise customers affected and offer credits (owner: Jess, due: 2026-03-22)
Ranjit: ok — marking RCA draft ready for sign-off and archiving into postmortems. plz reply `signoff` when you approve
Maria: signoff
Leo: signoff
Erin: signoff — LGTM
Ranjit: RCA status = signed-off by reviewers at 18:45 UTC. I'll create a ticket for tracking action items and link back to doc
incident-bot: Postmortem created: PM-1799502468 and linked to RCA doc
Sam: thanks team. follow-ups tracked, will update in sprint board. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
